data.context: In WIPO’s *Global Innovation Index 2026* (2026), this passage discusses the data envelopment analysis best-practice frontier and pillar contributions among the top 25 economies. It compares how France and Canada, and the United States and the Republic of Korea, draw on different GII pillars despite similar performance scores, and refers to Appendix II Figure 2 comparing DEA-BoD and GII scores across 139 economies.
